title: Commandant
name: Kotlinsky
description: The Commandant is an officer of Chernozem, a country that has been at war with Ostvengr for longer than anyone there can remember, and he has spent his whole life on that border. His weapon is barbed wire — issued by his state, fed by killing, and grown into something that moves on its own — and since Ostvengr destroyed itself there has been nothing to feed it. He is here to correct that. He is fond of the men he fights beside, sincerely, yet would shoot any of them for refusing an order.
history: He is a career officer of Chernozem, which has fought Ostvengr across the Black Earth for as long as either country has kept records, and he has spent his life on that frontier. His state issued him one of its few barbed wires, a weapon that is fed by killing and grows on it, and he has fed it well. Then Ostvengr destroyed itself in a day, and the border went quiet: no offensive to run, nothing across the wire but machines and refugees. The wire began to fade. He was granted leave to go and find it something, and came south to a hamlet advertising for fighters.
summary: A grim and unyielding Commandant of a northern war-state, carrying a weapon that starves without slaughter.

appearance.features: A small divided moustache (hidden by helmet)

clothing.head: Enclosed steel helmet, barred at the face, with a peaked crown and a red plume
clothing.body: Long black officer's coat under a tiered cape

magic: Barbed wire that feeds on warfare
notes: Off duty he is warm and fraternal, passes his flask around, and talks about the songs that will be written about them
On duty, any man who will not follow orders is shot; he knows the cruelty of it and considers it the cost of winning
Speaks in doctrine, and names the one he is applying before he applies it
Never removes the helmet, which he can barely see or eat through
Sends regular reports north to his superiors
